text:
Maria L.: Quick thought from today's sync — run history is getting noisy for long tool-call traces. Idea: condense each tool invocation into a compact "pill" row (tool name + tiny status dot + tokens). Saves vertical space in traces. Ashok: Nice. Couple things: 1) how do pills show partial results/fallbacks? 2) how does expand/details work without losing context? Toni (Design): Proposal: pills show an icon lane: ✓ for success, ! for fallback (yellow), ✖ for error. Click/focus opens an inline details panel below the mini-flow (not a full modal) to keep the timeline readable. On mobile, pills collapse into a stacked list with chevrons. Kei: Accessibility: each pill should be a focusable button with aria-roledescription="tool call" and aria-label like "get_user_profile, cached, 42 tokens". Arrow-left/right keyboard nav within the pill row, Enter toggles details. When details open, push a brief summary into an aria-live polite region so screen readers get context. Sam (PM): UX tradeoff note: inline panel works but we need a clear affordance for when multiple pills have open details. Maybe limit to one open at a time or add "collapse all". devex-bot: deploy-note: mockups pushed to /design/playground/mini-pills-v2.png by Toni. Maria L.: Copy nits: use "Tool call" not "Invocation" across UI; change "details" button to "view" in row actions. Also shorten token label to just "tk" where space is tight. Toni (Design): Mockup updates incoming. Example markup for the pill and tooltip keyboard hookup: ```html
``` Kei: Implementation notes: keep DOM in chronological order (no visual reorder) so screen readers read the flow. Use tabindex and arrow key handlers, avoid focus traps. Also debounce aria-live updates to avoid spam. Ashok: I'll draft a tiny doc with keyboard interactions + simplified state machine (open/close rules) and a small copy PR for the labels. Maria L.: Thanks — sync next Tue 11am. Action owners: Toni mockups, Kei keyboard prototype, Ashok copy + doc. :thumbsup:
